  $("#journal-2-private_notes").replaceWith('<span id=\"journal-2-private_notes\" class=\"badge badge-private private\">Private<\/span>');

  $("#journal-2-form").remove();
  var journal_header = $("#change-2>div.note>h4.journal-header>.journal-info");
  var journal_updated_info = journal_header.find("span.update-info");
  if (journal_updated_info.length > 0) {
    journal_updated_info.replaceWith('<span title=\"01/15/2026 12:00 PM by Redmine Admin\" class=\"update-info\">· Edited<\/span>');
